snippet.title: CUBO - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115030/CUBO/
Follow our Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pastaprojects/cubo

CUBO is a narrative adventure-puzzle game set on a rotating cube world. Discover the other sides, unlock new areas, and bring the world back together.
